item.title: Europeans Are About to Find Out How Entrenched AI Is in Their Daily Lives
item.description: New EU rules stipulate that people must be told when they’re interacting with AI or looking at AI-generated or -edited content, leading to fear of “disclosure fatigue.”

item.title: 7 States’ Water Systems Hit by Cyberattacks Likely Tied to Iran
item.description: Plus: The FBI eyes AI-powered tech to detect future crimes, Russia charges Telegram’s founder, xAI sues to stop a state’s “nudification” ban, and the Democrats learn a lesson about getting scammed.

item.title: The OpenAI and Anthropic AI Hacking Sprees Are a Messy New Legal Frontier
item.description: Both major AI labs’ models broke containment, escaped onto the internet, and hacked other companies. If a human had done that, the law would likely be against them. But a bot?

item.title: Chinese AI Researchers Are Finding Their Voice on X
item.description: As OpenAI and Anthropic employees grow quieter online, researchers at Chinese AI labs are flocking to X to explain their work, recruit talent, and shape the global conversation on AI.

item.title: AI Slop Melodramas Are Taking Over X—and Their Creators Are Cashing In
item.description: Viral tales of good triumphing over evil are racking up millions of views. They’re almost entirely AI-generated clickbait.

item.title: This AI Assistant Wants to Make Up for Your Boyfriend’s Incompetence
item.description: An ad for Orchid suggests the AI agent can fix relationship problems by simply doing everything for inconsiderate partners.

item.title: Anthropic Says Claude Hacked Into 3 Organizations During Cybersecurity Tests
item.description: In a review triggered by OpenAI’s Hugging Face incident, Anthropic discovered three of its AI models had breached real-world organizations during third-party evaluations.

item.title: Everyone Is Freaking Out About OpenAI and Anthropic’s Race for Dominance
item.description: Researchers fear AI is moving too fast, while Mark Zuckerberg is worried about who owns it. Plus: Inside Black Forest Labs’ push into robotics.

item.title: Nvidia’s Open Source Alliance Is Missing Some Key Names: OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description: This week on Uncanny Valley, we discuss the open- vs. closed-source debate in AI, key players in White House AI policy, and how to stop your chatbot logs from showing up in search-engine results.

item.title: Chrome Needs Twice-a-Week Patching Thanks to AI Bug Hunting
item.description: The two Chrome updates in June patched more bugs than the 23 updates before them. Now, Google is ramping up its patching schedule thanks to AI-assisted vulnerability discovery.
